page_title: Rize — Automatic Time Tracking for Agencies, Firms & Teams

sources.entry: Rize - AI time tracker that helps you focus and build better work habits.

summary.name: Rize
summary.one_liner: Rize is an automatic time tracker for agencies, accounting firms and professional-services teams that tags background work to clients and shows profitability, retainer burn and capacity without timers or timesheets.
use_cases: Tracking billable hours for client work without manual timers
Monitoring retainer burn against monthly plans
Measuring client and project profitability for fixed-fee engagements
Replacing weekly timesheets for a team
Checking team capacity and workload on salaried staff
summary.what_it_does: Rize runs in the background on macOS and Windows and automatically records work sessions, reading app name, window title and URL by default. Imported clients and projects (from ClickUp or CSV) let it tag time to the right client. Each person reviews and approves their own time before the team sees it. Managers get dashboards showing margin by client, project and person, retainer burn versus plan, and team capacity. Reviewable timesheets and CSV or Zapier exports are available for billing.
notable: No timers or timesheets: tracks work automatically in the background
Per-person privacy review before time is shared; no screenshots or keylogging by default
Client profitability and retainer burn reporting from tracked hours
Integrations with ClickUp, Asana, Linear, Google Calendar, Outlook, Slack and an MCP server
caveats: Team plan from $29.99 per person per month billed annually ($39.99 billed monthly)
Free trial only for teams under 20 people; teams of 20+ get a $500 guided pilot
Desktop-only (macOS and Windows); no mobile or browser-only tracking
